fields.name: appUser
fields.short: The agent user that is associated with this agent session.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was archived.

fields.name: codingHarnessModelLabel
fields.short: [Internal] Compact display label for the coding harness model used by this session, derived from the latest associated sandbox.

fields.name: comment
fields.short: The comment this agent session is associated with.

fields.name: context
fields.short: The entity contexts this session is related to, such as issues or projects referenced in direct chat sessions.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: creator
fields.short: The human user responsible for the agent session.

fields.name: dismissedAt
fields.short: The time a user dismissed this agent session.

fields.name: dismissedBy
fields.short: The user who dismissed the agent session.

fields.name: endedAt
fields.short: The time the agent session completed.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: issue
fields.short: The issue this agent session is associated with.

fields.name: modelSelection
fields.short: [Internal] How Adaptive selected the model route used by this coding session.

fields.name: plan
fields.short: A dynamically updated plan describing the agent's execution strategy, including steps to be taken and their current status.

fields.name: pullRequest
fields.short: The pull request this agent session is anchored to, when started from a pull request.

fields.name: slugId
fields.short: The agent session's unique URL slug.

fields.name: sourceComment
fields.short: The comment that this agent session was spawned from, if from a different thread.

fields.name: sourceMetadata
fields.short: Metadata about the external source that created this agent session.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.short: The time the agent session transitioned to active status and began work.

fields.name: status
fields.short: The current status of the agent session, such as pending, active, awaiting input, complete, error, or stale.

fields.name: summary
fields.short: The session title, generated automatically or set by the owning OAuth application.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated.

fields.name: url
fields.short: The URL to the agent session page in the Linear app.

fields.name: approximateNeedCount
fields.short: The approximate number of distinct requests associated with this customer, deduplicated per issue or project.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was archived.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: domains
fields.short: The email domains associated with this customer (e.g., 'acme.com').

fields.name: externalIds
fields.short: Identifiers for this customer in external systems (e.g., CRM IDs from Intercom, Salesforce, or HubSpot).

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: integration
fields.short: The integration that manages this customer's data (e.g., Intercom, Salesforce).

fields.name: logoUrl
fields.short: URL of the customer's logo image.

fields.name: mainSourceId
fields.short: The primary external source ID when a customer has data from multiple external systems.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The display name of the customer organization.

fields.name: owner
fields.short: The workspace member assigned as the owner of this customer.

fields.name: revenue
fields.short: The annual revenue generated by this customer.

fields.name: size
fields.short: The number of employees or seats at the customer organization.

fields.name: slackChannelId
fields.short: The ID of the Slack channel linked to this customer for communication.

fields.name: slugId
fields.short: A unique, human-readable URL slug for the customer.

fields.name: status
fields.short: The current lifecycle status of the customer.

fields.name: tier
fields.short: The tier or segment assigned to this customer for prioritization (e.g., Enterprise, Pro, Free).

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated.

fields.name: url
fields.short: The URL of the customer's page in the Linear application.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was archived.

fields.name: attachment
fields.short: The issue attachment linked to this need.

fields.name: body
fields.short: The body content of the need in Markdown format.

fields.name: bodyData
fields.short: [Internal] The body content of the need as a Prosemirror document JSON string.

fields.name: comment
fields.short: An optional comment providing additional context for this need.

fields.name: content
fields.short: The effective Markdown content shown for this customer need.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: creator
fields.short: The user who manually created this customer need.

fields.name: customer
fields.short: The customer organization this need belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: issue
fields.short: The issue this need is linked to.

fields.name: originalIssue
fields.short: The issue this customer need was originally created on, before being moved to a different issue or project.

fields.name: priority
fields.short: Whether the customer need is important or not.

fields.name: project
fields.short: The project this need is linked to.

fields.name: projectAttachment
fields.short: The project attachment linked to this need.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated.

fields.name: url
fields.short: The URL of the source attachment linked to this need, if any.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was archived.

fields.name: canceledAt
fields.short: [Internal] The time at which the initiative was moved into Canceled status.

fields.name: color
fields.short: The initiative's color.

fields.name: completedAt
fields.short: The time at which the initiative was moved into Completed status.

fields.name: content
fields.short: The initiative's content in markdown format.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: creator
fields.short: The user who created the initiative.

fields.name: description
fields.short: The description of the initiative.

fields.name: documentContent
fields.short: The content of the initiative description.

fields.name: frequencyResolution
fields.short: The resolution of the reminder frequency.

fields.name: health
fields.short: The overall health of the initiative, derived from the most recent initiative update.

fields.name: healthUpdatedAt
fields.short: The time at which the initiative health was last updated, typically when a new initiative update is posted.

fields.name: icon
fields.short: The icon of the initiative.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: identifier
fields.short: [Internal] The human-readable identifier of the initiative.

fields.name: integrationsSettings
fields.short: Settings for all integrations associated with that initiative.

fields.name: labelIds
fields.short: The IDs of the initiative labels associated with this initiative.

fields.name: lastUpdate
fields.short: The most recent status update posted for this initiative.

fields.name: leadTeam
fields.short: The team that leads the initiative.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The name of the initiative.

fields.name: organization
fields.short: The workspace of the initiative.

fields.name: owner
fields.short: The user who owns the initiative.

fields.name: parentInitiative
fields.short: Parent initiative associated with the initiative.

fields.name: previousIdentifiers
fields.short: [Internal] Identifiers (default and custom) that this initiative has previously held.

fields.name: priority
fields.short: The priority of the initiative.

fields.name: prioritySortOrder
fields.short: The sort order of the initiative within the workspace when ordered by priority.

fields.name: slugId
fields.short: The initiative's unique URL slug, used to construct human-readable URLs.

fields.name: sortOrder
fields.short: The sort order of the initiative within the workspace.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.short: The time at which the initiative was moved into Active status.

fields.name: status
fields.short: The lifecycle status of the initiative.

fields.name: targetDate
fields.short: The estimated completion date of the initiative.

fields.name: targetDateResolution
fields.short: The resolution of the initiative's estimated completion date, indicating whether it refers to a specific day, week, month, quarter, or year.

fields.name: trashed
fields.short: A flag that indicates whether the initiative is in the trash bin.

fields.name: updateReminderFrequency
fields.short: The frequency at which to prompt for updates.

fields.name: updateReminderFrequencyInWeeks
fields.short: The n-weekly frequency at which to prompt for updates.

fields.name: updateRemindersDay
fields.short: The day at which to prompt for updates.

fields.name: updateRemindersHour
fields.short: The hour at which to prompt for updates.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated.

fields.name: url
fields.short: Initiative URL.

fields.name: visibility
fields.short: The visibility of the initiative, derived from its lead team.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was archived.

fields.name: body
fields.short: The update content in markdown format.

fields.name: bodyData
fields.short: [Internal] The content of the update as a Prosemirror document.

fields.name: commentCount
fields.short: Number of comments associated with the initiative update.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: diff
fields.short: The diff between the current update and the previous one.

fields.name: diffMarkdown
fields.short: The diff between the current update and the previous one, formatted as markdown.

fields.name: editedAt
fields.short: The time the update was edited.

fields.name: health
fields.short: The health of the initiative at the time this update was posted.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: infoSnapshot
fields.short: [Internal] A snapshot of initiative properties at the time the update was posted, including project statuses, sub-initiative health, and target dates.

fields.name: initiative
fields.short: The initiative that this status update was posted to.

fields.name: isDiffHidden
fields.short: Whether the diff between this update and the previous one should be hidden in the UI.

fields.name: isStale
fields.short: Whether the initiative update is stale.

fields.name: reactionData
fields.short: Emoji reaction summary, grouped by emoji type.

fields.name: slugId
fields.short: The update's unique URL slug.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated.

fields.name: url
fields.short: The URL to the initiative update.

fields.name: user
fields.short: The user who wrote the update.

fields.name: projectMilestone
fields.short: The project milestone that the issue is associated with.

fields.name: reactionData
fields.short: Emoji reaction summary for the issue, grouped by emoji type.

fields.name: recurringIssueTemplate
fields.short: The recurring issue template that created this issue.

fields.name: slaBreachesAt
fields.short: The time at which the issue's SLA will breach.

fields.name: slaHighRiskAt
fields.short: The time at which the issue's SLA will enter high risk state.

fields.name: slaMediumRiskAt
fields.short: The time at which the issue's SLA will enter medium risk state.

fields.name: slaStartedAt
fields.short: The time at which the issue's SLA began.

fields.name: slaType
fields.short: The type of SLA set on the issue.

fields.name: snoozedBy
fields.short: The user who snoozed the issue.

fields.name: snoozedUntilAt
fields.short: The time until an issue will be snoozed in Triage view.

fields.name: sortOrder
fields.short: The order of the item in relation to other items in the organization.

fields.name: sourceComment
fields.short: The comment that this issue was created from, when an issue is created from an existing comment.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.short: The time at which the issue was moved into started state.

fields.name: startedTriageAt
fields.short: The time at which the issue entered triage.

fields.name: state
fields.short: The workflow state (issue status) that the issue is currently in.

fields.name: subIssueSortOrder
fields.short: The order of the item in the sub-issue list.

fields.name: suggestionsGeneratedAt
fields.short: [Internal] The time at which the most recent suggestions for this issue were generated.

fields.name: summary
fields.short: [Internal] AI-generated activity summary for this issue.

fields.name: team
fields.short: The team that the issue belongs to.

fields.name: title
fields.short: The issue's title.

fields.name: trashed
fields.short: A flag that indicates whether the issue is in the trash bin.

fields.name: triagedAt
fields.short: The time at which the issue left triage.

fields.name: trusted
fields.short: [Internal] Whether this issue has been explicitly marked as trusted.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated.

fields.name: url
fields.short: Issue URL.

fields.name: agentAutomationEnabled

fields.name: aiAddonEnabled

fields.name: aiDiscussionSummariesEnabled

fields.name: aiProviderConfiguration
fields.short: [INTERNAL] Configure per-modality AI host providers and model families.

fields.name: aiTelemetryEnabled

fields.name: aiThreadSummariesEnabled
fields.short: Whether the workspace has enabled resolved thread AI summaries.

fields.name: allowedFileUploadContentTypes
fields.short: Allowed file upload content types

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was archived.

fields.name: authSettings
fields.short: Authentication settings for the workspace, including allowed auth providers, bypass rules, and organization visibility during signup.

fields.name: codeIntelligenceEnabled
fields.short: [INTERNAL] Whether code intelligence is enabled for the workspace.

fields.name: codeIntelligenceRepository
fields.short: [INTERNAL] GitHub repository in owner/repo format for code intelligence.

fields.name: codingAgentEnabled
fields.short: [INTERNAL] Whether the workspace has enabled Coding Sessions.

fields.name: codingAgentSettings
fields.short: [Internal] Settings for Coding Sessions features.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: createdIssueCount
fields.short: Approximate total number of issues created in the workspace, including archived ones.

fields.name: customerCount
fields.short: The number of active (non-archived) customers tracked in the workspace.

fields.name: customersConfiguration
fields.short: Configuration settings for the Customers feature, including revenue currency and other customer tracking preferences.

fields.name: customersEnabled
fields.short: Whether the Customers feature is enabled and accessible for the workspace based on the current plan.

fields.name: defaultFeedSummarySchedule
fields.short: Default schedule for how often feed summaries are generated.

fields.name: defaultHomeView
fields.short: The default home view for members of the workspace who have not chosen their own default.

fields.name: defaultHomeViewTargetId
fields.short: The id of the specific initiative, project, view, dashboard, or page tab used as the default home view.

fields.name: deletionRequestedAt
fields.short: The time at which deletion of the workspace was requested.

fields.name: feedEnabled
fields.short: Whether the activity feed feature is enabled for the workspace.

fields.name: fiscalYearStartMonth
fields.short: The zero-indexed month at which the fiscal year starts (0 = January, 11 = December).

fields.name: generatedUpdatesEnabled
fields.short: [INTERNAL] Whether the workspace has enabled generated updates.

fields.name: gitBranchFormat
fields.short: The template format for Git branch names created from issues.

fields.name: gitLinkbackDescriptionsEnabled

fields.name: gitPublicLinkbackMessagesEnabled

fields.name: hipaaComplianceEnabled
fields.short: Whether HIPAA compliance is enabled for the workspace.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: initiativeUpdateReminderFrequencyInWeeks
fields.short: The frequency in weeks at which to prompt for initiative updates.

fields.name: initiativeUpdateRemindersDay
fields.short: The day of the week on which initiative update reminders are sent.

fields.name: initiativeUpdateRemindersHour
fields.short: The hour of the day (0-23) at which initiative update reminders are sent.

fields.name: linearAgentEnabled
fields.short: [Internal] Whether the workspace has enabled Linear Agent.

fields.name: linearAgentSettings
fields.short: [Internal] Settings for Linear Agent features.

fields.name: logoUrl
fields.short: The URL of the workspace's logo image.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The workspace's name.

fields.name: periodUploadVolume

fields.name: previousUrlKeys

fields.name: projectUpdateReminderFrequencyInWeeks
fields.short: The frequency in weeks at which to prompt for project updates.

fields.name: projectUpdateRemindersDay
fields.short: The day of the week on which project update reminders are sent.

fields.name: projectUpdateRemindersHour
fields.short: The hour of the day (0-23) at which project update reminders are sent.

fields.name: pullRequestIssueMode
fields.short: How Linear suggests and links issues for pull requests that have none linked: 'off', 'suggest', or 'autoOnMerge'.

fields.name: pullRequestTourEnabled
fields.short: Whether the workspace generates AI Pull Request guides for new pull requests.

fields.name: releaseChannel
fields.short: The feature release channel the workspace belongs to, which controls access to pre-release features.

fields.name: releasesEnabled
fields.short: Whether release management is enabled for the workspace.

fields.name: restrictAgentInvocationToMembers
fields.short: [Internal] Whether agent invocation is restricted to full workspace members.

fields.name: roadmapEnabled

fields.name: samlEnabled

fields.name: samlSettings
fields.short: [INTERNAL] SAML settings.

fields.name: scimEnabled

fields.name: scimSettings
fields.short: [INTERNAL] SCIM settings.

fields.name: securitySettings

fields.name: slackProjectChannelPrefix

fields.name: slackProjectChannelsEnabled

fields.name: subscription

fields.name: themeSettings

fields.name: trialEndsAt

fields.name: trialStartsAt

fields.name: activeCycle
fields.short: Team's currently active cycle.

fields.name: aiDiscussionSummariesEnabled
fields.short: Whether to enable AI discussion summaries for issues in this team.

fields.name: aiThreadSummariesEnabled
fields.short: Whether to enable resolved thread AI summaries.

fields.name: allMembersCanJoin
fields.short: Whether all members in the workspace can join the team.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was archived.

fields.name: autoArchivePeriod
fields.short: Period after which automatically closed, completed, and duplicate issues are automatically archived in months.

fields.name: autoCloseChildIssues
fields.short: Whether child issues should automatically close when their parent issue is closed

fields.name: autoCloseParentIssues
fields.short: Whether parent issues should automatically close when all child issues are closed

fields.name: autoClosePeriod
fields.short: Period after which issues are automatically closed in months.

fields.name: autoCloseStateId
fields.short: The canceled workflow state which auto closed issues will be set to.

fields.name: color
fields.short: The team's color.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: currentProgress
fields.short: [Internal] The current progress of the team.

fields.name: cycleCalenderUrl
fields.short: Calendar feed URL (iCal) for cycles.

fields.name: cycleCooldownTime
fields.short: The cooldown time after each cycle in weeks.

fields.name: cycleDuration
fields.short: The duration of each cycle in weeks.

fields.name: cycleIssueAutoAssignCompleted
fields.short: Auto assign completed issues to current cycle.

fields.name: cycleIssueAutoAssignStarted
fields.short: Auto assign started issues to current cycle.

fields.name: cycleLockToActive
fields.short: Auto assign issues to current cycle if in active status.

fields.name: cycleStartDay
fields.short: The day of the week that a new cycle starts (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, ..., 6 = Saturday).

fields.name: cyclesEnabled
fields.short: Whether the team uses cycles for sprint-style issue management.

fields.name: defaultIssueEstimate
fields.short: What to use as a default estimate for unestimated issues.

fields.name: defaultIssueState
fields.short: The default workflow state into which issues are set when they are opened by team members.

fields.name: defaultProjectTemplate
fields.short: The default template to use for new projects created for the team.

fields.name: defaultTemplateForMembers
fields.short: The default template to use for new issues created by members of the team.

fields.name: defaultTemplateForNonMembers
fields.short: The default template to use for new issues created by non-members of the team.

fields.name: description
fields.short: The team's description.

fields.name: displayName
fields.short: The name of the team including its parent team name if it has one.

fields.name: groupIssueHistory
fields.short: Whether to group recent issue history entries.

fields.name: icon
fields.short: The icon of the team.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: inheritIssueEstimation
fields.short: Whether the team should inherit its estimation settings from its parent.

fields.name: inheritProjectStatuses
fields.short: [Internal] Whether the team should inherit its project statuses from its parent team, or from the workspace when it has no parent.

fields.name: inheritSlackAutoCreateProjectChannel
fields.short: [Internal] Whether the team should inherit its Slack auto-create project channel setting from its parent.

fields.name: inheritWorkflowStatuses
fields.short: Whether the team should inherit its workflow statuses from its parent.

fields.name: initiativesEnabled
fields.short: Whether team initiatives are enabled and shown in the team's sidebar.

fields.name: integrationsSettings
fields.short: Settings for all integrations associated with that team.

fields.name: issueCount
fields.short: The total number of issues in the team.

fields.name: issueEstimationAllowZero
fields.short: Whether to allow zeros in issues estimates.

fields.name: issueEstimationExtended
fields.short: Whether to add additional points to the estimate scale.

fields.name: issueEstimationType
fields.short: The issue estimation type to use.

fields.name: joinByDefault
fields.short: [Internal] Whether new users should join this team by default.

fields.name: key
fields.short: The team's unique key, used as a prefix in issue identifiers (e.g., 'ENG' in 'ENG-123') and in URLs.

fields.name: ledInitiativeCount
fields.short: The number of initiatives led by this team that would be deleted along with it.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The team's name.

fields.name: organization
fields.short: The workspace that the team belongs to.

fields.name: parent
fields.short: The team's parent team.

fields.name: progressHistory
fields.short: [Internal] The progress history of the team.

fields.name: requirePriorityToLeaveTriage
fields.short: Whether an issue needs to have a priority set before leaving triage.

fields.name: restrictedBy
fields.short: [Internal] For restricted teams, the enclosing private team that forms the visibility boundary.

fields.name: restrictedById
fields.short: [Internal] The identifier of the enclosing private team that forms the visibility boundary for restricted teams.

fields.name: retiredAt
fields.short: The time at which the team was retired.

fields.name: scimGroupName
fields.short: The SCIM group name for the team.

fields.name: scimManaged
fields.short: Whether the team is managed by a SCIM integration.

fields.name: securitySettings
fields.short: Security settings for the team, including role-based restrictions for issue sharing, label management, member management, template management, and agent skills.

fields.name: setIssueSortOrderOnStateChange
fields.short: Where to move issues when changing state.

fields.name: slackAutoCreateProjectChannel
fields.short: [Internal] Whether to automatically create a Slack channel when a new project is created in this team.

fields.name: timezone
fields.short: The timezone of the team.

fields.name: triageEnabled
fields.short: Whether triage mode is enabled for the team.

fields.name: triageIssueState
fields.short: The workflow state into which issues are set when they are opened by non-team members or integrations if triage is enabled.

fields.name: triageResponsibility
fields.short: Team's triage responsibility.

fields.name: upcomingCycleCount
fields.short: How many upcoming cycles to create.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated.

fields.name: visibility
fields.short: The visibility of the team.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was archived.

fields.name: autoAssignToSelf
fields.short: Whether to auto-assign newly created issues to the current user by default.

fields.name: calendarHash
fields.short: A unique hash for the user, used to construct secure calendar subscription URLs.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The time at which the entity was created.

fields.name: feedLastSeenTime
fields.short: The user's last seen time for the pulse feed.

fields.name: feedSummarySchedule
fields.short: The user's preferred schedule for receiving feed summary digests.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the entity.

fields.name: pullRequestMergeStrategyPreference
fields.short: [Internal] The user's preferred merge method for pull requests.

fields.name: showFullUserNames
fields.short: Whether to show full user names instead of display names.

fields.name: subscribedToChangelog
fields.short: Whether this user is subscribed to receive changelog emails about Linear product updates.

fields.name: subscribedToDPA
fields.short: Whether this user is subscribed to receive Data Processing Agreement (DPA) related emails.

fields.name: subscribedToInviteAccepted
fields.short: Whether this user is subscribed to receive email notifications when their workspace invitations are accepted.

fields.name: subscribedToPrivacyLegalUpdates
fields.short: Whether this user is subscribed to receive emails about privacy policy and legal updates.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The last time at which the entity was meaningfully updated.

fields.name: user
fields.short: The user that these settings belong to.
